#### 1.2.2 Migration Incentive Structure: Time-Bound Discounts & Complementary Bonuses

**Objective:** Create meaningful financial incentive for perpetual customers to voluntarily switch to subscriptions, but with escalating timeline (discount diminishes as time goes on, creating urgency without pressure). Combine discounts with non-monetary incentives (support, training, recognition) to address different customer motivations.

**Three-Tier Incentive Framework:**

**TIER 1: Early Adopter Phase (Months 1-6)**
- **Eligibility:** Any perpetual customer with active license or current renewal
- **Offer Components:**
  - Subscription price = 25% discount off list price; locked for 3 years
  - Free migration support (dedicated migration manager for top 50 accounts; standard support for others)
  - 90-day parallel run period (run perpetual + subscription simultaneously; zero downtime risk)
  - Free training (on-site or virtual; up to 8 hours)
  - Public case study opportunity (if willing; recognizes customer as pioneer)
  - Quarterly business review (for first year post-migration)
- **Term commitment:** 3-year commitment (annual billing, but multi-year discount locked)
- **Messaging:** "Pioneers get the best deal. First 6 months, get 25% off subscription locked for 3 years, plus white-glove migration support and public recognition as early adopter."
- **Expected migration rate:** 15-20% of installed base (early adopters, risk-comfortable, growth-focused customers)
- **Financial Impact (Mid-Market example, $20K subscription list price):**
  - Tier 1 price: $15K/year × 3 years = $45K total
  - vs. Perpetual maintenance for 3 years: $20K (Year 1) + $20.6K (Y2, 3% increase) + $21.2K (Y3) = $61.8K
  - Customer saves: $16.8K over 3 years
  - Company margin: Subscription margin 70% × $15K = $10.5K/year; Perpetual margin 40% × $20K = $8K/year
  - Year 1: Margin trade-off ($8K perpetual → $10.5K subscription) = +$2.5K, even with discount

---

**TIER 2: Standard Migration Phase (Months 7-18)**
- **Eligibility:** Any perpetual customer with active license or current renewal
- **Offer Components:**
  - Subscription price = 15% discount off list price; locked for 2 years
  - Standard migration support (project manager assigned; weekly check-ins; self-service tools + community forum)
  - 60-day parallel run period
  - Free training (up to 4 hours; virtual)
  - Optional case study (public testimonial; no obligation)
  - Quarterly business review (for first year)
- **Term commitment:** 2-year minimum (annual billing)
- **Messaging:** "Join the evolution. 15% off subscription for 2 years, plus our standard migration support. See what early movers have experienced."
- **Expected migration rate:** 25-30% of installed base (pragmatic customers; seeing early movers succeed; ready to switch)
- **Financial Impact (same example):**
  - Tier 2 price: $17K/year × 2 years = $34K total
  - vs. Perpetual maintenance for 2 years: $20K + $20.6K = $40.6K
  - Customer saves: $6.6K over 2 years
  - Year 1 margin: $11.9K subscription (70% margin on $17K) vs. $8K perpetual = +$3.9K, even with discount

---

**TIER 3: Final Migration Window (Months 19-36)**
- **Eligibility:** Remaining perpetual customers (excluding those who have explicitly declined)
- **Offer Components:**
  - Subscription price = 5% discount off list price; locked for 1 year
  - Self-service migration tools + community support forum
  - 30-day parallel run period
  - Optional training (1 hour virtual check-in)
  - No case study opportunity
  - Messaging emphasizes deadline: "Last chance for locked-in migration pricing; perpetual licenses will be transitioned in 36 months."
- **Term commitment:** 1-year minimum (annual billing)
- **Messaging:** "The future is now. Last chance for locked-in migration pricing. After Month 36, perpetual will be legacy-supported only."
- **Expected migration rate:** 20-25% of installed base (pragmatists; responding to deadline; seeing market move)
- **Financial Impact:**
  - Tier 3 price: $19K/year × 1 year = $19K total vs. perpetual $20K = customer pays slightly less
  - Year 1 margin: $13.3K subscription vs. $8K perpetual = +$5.3K gain even with discount

---

**TIER 4: Post-Migration Window (Months 37+)**
- **Eligibility:** Perpetual customers who did not migrate by Month 36
- **Offer:**
  - Subscription at full list price ($20K/year); no discount
  - Perpetual license support (legacy track) = EOL in 5 years (Month 60) with declining support intensity
  - Extended support available at premium cost ($5K/year)
- **Messaging:** "Perpetual licenses are now legacy. We support them for 5 more years with limited updates, then they retire. Subscription is the only forward path. Migrate now at list price or plan your transition."
- **Expected migration rate:** 5-10% of installed base (hold-outs; large enterprise; willing to pay premium; may eventually switch or churn)
- **Financial Impact:** Margin per customer drops from subscription to legacy-perpetual (low support intensity); customer retention at risk
